fusions.name: Spadeful
fusions.desc: A heavy spadeful that deals 9 earth damage. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Turned Out
fusions.desc: Heaves earth outward, dealing 10 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. You restore 8 health.

fusions.name: Trench Held
fusions.desc: Digs in behind a barrier that absorbs the next 26 damage and holds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Dug-Up Hound
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar of earth that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage. Each kill restores 3 health to you.
